title: SEC2: Entire blob buffered in memory before disk write
description:
fetch_peer_blob collects the entire HTTP response body into memory via Limited::collect().await before writing to BlobStore.

File: crates/kithd/src/peer_fetch.rs, lines 443-456

For a 100MB attachment, this buffers 100MB in RAM. The BlobStore::write_blob API accepts &[u8], but streaming is possible.

Impact: Large attachments cause unnecessary memory pressure. Measure feasibility of streaming hash+write pipeline using tokio::io::AsyncRead traits.
